message.reasoning:
need to fix compilation errors. The test code tries to use JUnit 5 assertions (assertEquals, assertTrue, assertThrows) but they are not imported statically. Need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; Also need to import org.mockito.Mockito.* but they created custom mock framework. They also have a custom ArgumentMatchers class, but they also need static import for when, any, eq, anyString etc. They defined static method when in test class, and ArgumentMatchers with any, anyString, any(Class), eq. However they call any() without class param; they defined any() generic returns null. But they also call any(JsonNode.class) expecting overloaded any(Class). They have any(Class<T>) defined. So need to import static methods? They call any() directly; since they are in same class, static method any() defined inside ArgumentMatchers not static import. Actually they defined static class ArgumentMatchers with static methods any(), anyString(), any(Class), eq. But they call any() directly, not ArgumentMatchers.any(). Since they are in same outer class, static nested class methods are not directly accessible without qualification unless imported static. They could add static import: import static PrefixItemsValidator_validate_Test.ArgumentMatchers.*; Or add static methods to outer class delegating. Simpler: add static imports at top: import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; and import static PrefixItemsValidator_validate_Test.ArgumentMatchers.*; Also need import static PrefixItemsValidator_validate_Test.when; but they have static method when defined in outer class, so static import not needed if they call when directly (method in same class). That's fine.

Also need to remove the custom MockitoExtension class conflict with real import. They imported org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension which doesn't exist. They also defined a static class MockitoExtension empty. To avoid import error, remove import line and the @ExtendWith annotation referencing it, or change to use the custom class. Simpler: delete import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; and change @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) to use the inner class. Since they defined static class MockitoExtension, we can keep annotation but need to import ExtendWith (already imported). The import of MockitoExtension is causing error. Remove that import.

Also need to remove @Override on getTupleSchema? The error at line 186: method does not override or implement a method from a supertype. That's in SimpleJsonSchema class: they have @Override on getTupleSchema but JsonSchema likely doesn't have that method? Actually JsonSchema has getTupleSchema? Possibly not. So remove @Override annotation from getTupleSchema.

Also need to import java.lang.reflect.* already there.

Also need to import java.util.Collection etc. Already.

Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension. Already.

Now also need to fix anyString etc: they defined anyString in ArgumentMatchers, but also they call anyString() directly. So static import needed.

Add static import for ArgumentMatchers methods.

Also need to import java.util.Set, List etc already.

Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.* for assertEquals etc.

Now any other errors: they use when(validationContext.newSchema(anyString(), any(JsonNode.class), any(JsonSchema.class))) but any(JsonSchema.class) expects Class param; they defined any(Class<T>) generic. That's fine.

But they also call any() with no args for ExecutionContext param etc. any() returns null generic.

Now need to ensure when method works: they have static when(T methodCall) that uses LAST_INVOKE. That's fine.

Now need to ensure when(...).thenReturn works; OngoingStubbing thenReturn expects varargs.

Now need to ensure imports for Set.of (Java 9) okay.

Now need to adjust anyString method name conflict with java.util.Any? fine.

Now need to add static import for ArgumentMatchers.any, anyString, eq.

Add at top: import static PrefixItemsValidator_validate_Test.ArgumentMatchers.*;

Also need to import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

Now also need to import java.util.stream.Stream; already.

Now need to remove the duplicate static class MockitoExtension? It's okay.

Now compile errors about method anyString not found resolved.

Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.* for assertThrows etc.

Now also need to import java.util.Collection already.

Now check any other errors: they use Set.of in Java 9; okay.

Now also need to import java.util.ArrayDeque, HashMap etc already.

Now need to ensure test class is public? Not required.

Now implement changes.
